summary: Iteration 22 backend: 7/7 tests PASS (100%). Tested: (1) GET /api/properties/{id}/dynamic-pricing returns days[] with base/market/suggested/factors/delta, occupancy_rate, comps_count, market_city, config; suggested is numeric >=0; every Fri/Sat between 2026-08-01..15 has 'week-end' factor; invalid dates → 400; unknown id → 404. (2) PUT /api/properties/{id} with dynamic_pricing={enabled:true, weekend_pct:20} persists; a subsequent PUT WITHOUT the dynamic_pricing key does NOT wipe it (weekend_pct=20 still returned by GET /property and by /dynamic-pricing config). (3) Property.photos preserved: PUT with photos=['a.jpg','b.jpg'] then GET returns exactly that list; PUT with photos=[] clears; original values restored after test. (4) Fix rating=0 → clamped to 1; rating=7 → 5. Frontend smoke: /login → password login works (Home reached); Home displays testID='stmt-pending-card' and 'stmt-pending-toggle' — the collapsible 'Cautions à suivre' / 'Relevés à suivre' encart is present and the chevron toggles collapse/expand. Screens /kpi, /reviews, /settings/promotions (Ajouter une promotion form) all render without red-screen. Planning multi-property price toggle and reservation-form checklist could not be re-verified via Playwright in this run due to intermittent Google reCAPTCHA/login latency after the first successful session — all their backend contracts, however, are validated in test_iter21_features.py (checklist) and test_iter22_features.py (dynamic pricing + photos). No deprecated Expo packages detected (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch not present). All TEST_-prefixed reviews were deleted; property photos & dynamic_pricing restored to original values (no real property data mutated).
action_items: (Optional) The web-preview login flow is occasionally flaky when the same headless browser context re-navigates to /login and the 'Se connecter avec un email et un mot de passe' reveal must be clicked before the two inputs render — first attempt always works, later attempts sometimes stay on /login. Not a product bug but consider a testID on the reveal link and the final submit button (currently only detectable by text 'Se connecter') to make automated retries reliable.

(Optional/Cleanup) DEFAULT_DYNAMIC_PRICING is loaded via {**DEFAULT_DYNAMIC_PRICING, **prop['dynamic_pricing']} which is good; consider adding a Pydantic sub-model to validate weekend_pct etc. and prevent NaN input.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py grew to ~4931 lines — splitting into modules (pricing.py, properties.py, reservations.py, reviews.py) would improve maintainability.

PUT /api/properties/{id} correctly guards against wiping dynamic_pricing / lodgify_id / owner_id when the key is absent from payload (lines 373-378) — good pattern; document it for future added-optional fields.

success_rate.frontend: Partially verified: Home (stmt-pending toggle+card OK), /kpi OK, /reviews OK, /settings/promotions form OK. Planning multi-price and reservation-form checklist not re-verified in this run (see action_items).

seed_data_creation: No permanent seed. Two TEST_iter22_* reviews created and immediately deleted; a real property was momentarily updated with photos=['a.jpg','b.jpg'] and dynamic_pricing={enabled:true, weekend_pct:20} then restored to original values in the test's finally block. No real properties or reservations were created or deleted.
